overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: three selectmen who met in the office discussed vacations, not Board business, so no illegal deliberation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated privately in the Board office on July 6 while three members were present.
allegations.key_passage: We credit the Board's statement and find no evidence that the three Board members present in the Selectmen's office on July 6 improperly deliberated outside of a meeting.
